verdict.rationale: FreshBooks documents bank linking with "automated workflows for bank reconciliation and transaction management" and real-time expense tracking. That loosely implies some automated handling of imported transactions, but nothing describes categorization suggestions or any learning from corrections. Missing for 10: explicit auto-categorization suggestions for imported bank transactions, learning from user corrections or recategorization rules, detailed first-party documentation of the feature, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
